what: This demonstration follows a question, not a measurement: what might repeated radar observations reveal where groundwater pumping could compact sediment beneath a growing city?
drivers: Groundwater withdrawal can lower pore-water pressure.
Compressible sediments may settle as support changes.
Local geology and water use determine where risk concentrates.

radarChannel.name: Repeat-pass InSAR · L-band concept
radarChannel.description: Compare the phase of radar echoes from repeat passes to estimate relative surface motion. A real result needs co-registered products, processing, uncertainty checks, and local validation.

affected: Households, roads, water systems, and essential services may be exposed where ground movement overlaps with dense development. This is a general impact pathway, not a site-specific impact assessment.

nisarBrowseRecords.note: ASF's November 14, 2026 PROVISIONAL GUNW catalog query returned this record with a product footprint intersecting the Quetta search point. This verifies product availability at that point only; the browse image is not a displacement estimate and does not validate the illustrative subsidence story.
